a7c6c9696e39b26fe986.text: When you do your research, you need to cite or list your sources. Whenever you take

d5c56734d80cc4795983.text: specific facts, ideas, or quotations from a book, magazine, newspaper, or other sources, you make sure to cite the source.

3a065ee657132eda52ff.text: Here are some important reasons why you need to cite or list the sources: •

543b8ab8ef3a2bbb9076.text: It gives credit to the authors. • It provides you and the reader with more information about the sources. • It shows the writer’s credibility, referring to whether his/her sources are reliable. • It prevents plagiarism, an act of stealing someone else’s ideas and presenting them as your own.

d09bd0ab95d517f8ef13.text: Look at the sample text inside the box. How many sources do you see? One way of

96ebdefde18e7214f06b.text: citing your sources is through listing them on a separate page of your research paper. This page is what we call as a bibliography.

21f5c955ae085edd34d3.text: A bibliography is taken from the Greek word ‘biblion’, which means ‘book’ and ‘graphia’, which means ‘to write.’ A bibliography contains an alphabetical list of sources like

4c7cffa98ffe06bb5a14.text: books, periodicals, and websites used by the writer or researcher.

b1d2b74f597a05a39e3e.text: A research paper should contain a bibliography written on a separate page and should

15e52fdb5fe0ac780a73.text: be located at the end of the paper. Each entry uses a hanging indention, also known as a second line indention.

4c745a39eaab567ea2e8.text: There are many styles or formats in citing or listing sources, depending on the subject.

1604f4e5f5a3612c43a6.text: The three main citation styles are the following:The American Psychological Association (APA) Style which is used in social and behavioral sciences.

de4d31660819d787065c.text: The Modern Language Association (MLA) Style which is used for writing papers on

1f1e6d32a97ebc1cf560.text: literature and related subjects like theater or film.

8c044d287448420b96a6.text: The Chicago Manual of Style (CMOS) which is often used in many academic fields,

f6298bcfcb315360911e.text: especially in the humanities and social sciences.

2aefde55a15fd7126d74.text: In this module, we will follow the bibliography annotation standard specified in Chicago
